title: The Sword Affinity Primer
summary: Teaches a beginner to draw sword qi along the breath and make the first plain cuts guards and steps of the sword affinity.

title: A Drill-Book of the Drawn Edge
summary: A drill-book of rising and falling cuts that trains the student to carry a thin edge of qi through every draw.

title: Handbook of Sword Breathing
summary: A short handbook that joins sword form to the slow breathing of the affinity so qi and steel move as one.

title: Workbook of the Qi Edge
summary: A workbook on coating the blade with qi and loosing thin edges from it for students who can already circulate.

title: A Short Canon of the Sheathed Sword
summary: A short canon on drawing from the scabbard and guarding with it so the sword is ready before the hand moves.

title: Treatise on the Leading Point
summary: A treatise on thrusts and the qi gathered at the tip of the sword that lets the point lead the whole body.

title: The Plain Guard Primer
summary: A primer on holding the sword as a guard with qi spread along the flat and answering a blow with a cut.

title: Handbook of Steady Steps and Edges
summary: A handbook that drills footwork with the edge so each cut is carried by a balanced body and a settled weight.

title: Drill-Book of Sword Sense
summary: A drill-book on resting a hand on the hilt to read reach and guard and on steadying the hand before a cut.

title: A Primer on the Rising Cut
summary: A primer that builds upward cuts and the lifting guard from the first draw to a settled rising stroke of sword qi.
